content.short: Trustblock secures and simplifies the Web3 ecosystem.
content.description: Trustblock consolidates dispersed security audits into structured, verifiable on-chain data, addressing key Web3 transparency gaps. By making audit authenticity, authorship, and comprehensiveness easily accessible and verifiable, it strengthens trust among users, platforms, and protocols. With solutions like LabelSec and DataSec, Trustblock helps platforms integrate audit-derived data seamlessly, boosting security and user confidence across networks.
content.meta: Trustblock turns audits into verifiable on-chain data to improve Web3 security. Discover Trustblock and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
